decisions.reason: The peak-alignment clarification reinforces but does not change the existing requirement that the accent literally duplicate the Hero V terminal geometry.
The second-V hierarchy is a separate decision in the same message and is already fully represented by its message-138 INTRODUCE Event; the peak-alignment modification adds no further change.
The source changes the vertical hierarchy of the second V, not its construction method or established right-arm reach.
Using the Hero V peak as the alignment reference does not itself change any established Hero V geometry attribute.
The second V is positioned relative to the E and L heights, but the source does not alter the E or L construction, aesthetics, role, or terminal constraints.
The peak and height hierarchy refinements do not change the wordmark's kerning, spacing, or cadence requirements.
The construction-sheet refinements do not change the obligation to provide rationale for design rounds.
The source concerns vector geometry and hierarchy and does not resume or modify the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
The source does not change the all-caps case treatment or its selection status.
The source contains no decision about review-image delivery formats or file accessibility.
